# Human Kinetics

> > Human Kinetics is a leading publisher of educational resources for health, fitness, physical education, and sport science, offering textbooks, online courses, and continuing education for certifications including NSCA, ACE, ACSM, and BOC.

Human Kinetics provides comprehensive resources through their HKPropel digital platform, including textbooks, instructor ancillaries, and certification exam preparation materials. They partner with major organizations like SHAPE America, NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association), and BOC to deliver evidence-based content for students, educators, fitness professionals, and athletic trainers.

## Key Topics

- HKPropel (digital learning platform)
- NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association)
- Physical Education
- Exercise Science
- Continuing Education & Certification
- Strength & Conditioning
- Athletic Training

- SHAPE America

- Fitness Certifications (ACE, ACSM, AFPA)
- Resistance Training

- Instructor Resources & Ancillaries

## Core Products & Collections

- [Human Kinetics](https://us.humankinetics.com): Homepage: Publisher of health, physical activity books, journals & courses
- [Books](https://us.humankinetics.com/collections/books): Complete catalog of sports, fitness & physical education books
- [Continuing Education](https://us.humankinetics.com/collections/continuing-education): Online CE courses for fitness certifications (ACE, ACSM, NSCA, etc.)
- [Courses](https://us.humankinetics.com/collections/courses): Online courses including NSCA CSCS certification study programs
- [Collections](https://us.humankinetics.com/products): Browse all product collections organized by certification & topic
- [Strength Training](https://us.humankinetics.com/collections/strength-training): Strength training books, courses & NSCA certification resources
- [Featured Products](https://us.humankinetics.com/collections/featured-products): Featured fitness & anatomy books including Stretching Anatomy 3rd Edition

## Certification & Exam Preparation

- [BOC Exam Reference Titles](https://us.humankinetics.com/pages/boc-exam-reference-titles): 26 BOC athletic training certification exam reference titles (2025-2026)
- [NSCA's Essentials of Sport Science](https://us.humankinetics.com/products/nscas-essentials-of-sport-science): NSCA textbook for CPSS certification by French & Torres Ronda
- [The Essential Guide for Mental Performance Consultants](https://us.humankinetics.com/products/essential-guide-for-mental-performance-consultants-digital-resource-the): AASP digital guide for CMPC certification exam preparation
- [Physical Education edTPA Online Preparation Guide](https://us.humankinetics.com/products/physical-education-edtpa-online-preparation-guide): edTPA exam prep course for PE preservice teachers by Johnson & Brummitt
- [Exercise Technique Manual for Resistance Training 4th Edition](https://us.humankinetics.com/products/exercise-technique-manual-for-resistance-training-4th-edition-ebook-with-hkpropel-online-video): NSCA resistance training ebook with HKPropel video demonstrations

## Physical Education Resources

- [Physical Education Textbooks](https://us.humankinetics.com/collections/physical-education/textbooks): Physical education textbooks for PETE programs and K-12 teachers
- [SHAPE America Resources](https://us.humankinetics.com/pages/about-shape-america-resources): SHAPE America partnership resources for PE & health education standards
- [Complete Guide to Primary Gymnastics](https://us.humankinetics.com/products/complete-guide-to-primary-gymnastics): Primary gymnastics teaching guide by Lindsay Broomfield with DVD

- [Learn more about physical activity epidemiology](https://us.humankinetics.com/blogs/excerpt/learn-more-about-physical-activity-epidemiology): Excerpt on physical activity epidemiology from Introduction to Exercise Science
- [Why game play is just as important as a tactical approach](https://us.humankinetics.com/blogs/excerpt/why-game-play-is-just-as-important-as-a-tactical-approach): Excerpt on tactical games approach from Teaching Sport Concepts & Skills

- [Guided Discovery](https://us.humankinetics.com/blogs/excerpt/guided-discovery): Guided discovery coaching method excerpt from Athletic Movement Skills
- [Nine principles of designing exercise progressions and regressions](https://us.humankinetics.com/blogs/excerpt/nine-principles-of-designing-exercise-progressions-and-regressions): Exercise programming principles from Secrets of Successful Program Design
